assinar.explica: Invite up to 3 people to sign this post with you. Each name only shows up after that person accepts, and anyone who accepted can stop signing whenever they want.
assinar.cheio: That is already 3 people. Remove an invitation to call someone else.
assinar.feito: Invitation sent. The name only shows on the post if the person accepts.
assinar.jaFeito: This person was already called for this post.
assinar.convidadaTexto: If you accept, your codename shows on this post together with the writer's. You can stop signing later.
assinar.aceitou: Done: your codename shows on this post.
assinar.noTopoUm: Someone asked you to sign a post together.
assinar.noTopoVarios: {n} invitations to sign together are waiting for your answer.

fonte.pedirRotulo: Source? Ask the author, without your name
fonte.regra: The request reaches the author without your name. Nobody sees who asked; only the author and the mediators see how many asked, and the number only from 3 on.
fonte.poucos: People asked for the source of this post.
fonte.muitos: {n} people asked for the source of this post.
fonte.explica: A link to the source, a Vale o Escrito check, or both. Whoever asked for the source gets a notice.
fonte.posta: Source published. Whoever asked gets a notice.
fonte.tirada: The source was removed from the post.
fonte.pedidoFeito: Request sent to the author, without your name.

marcar.explica: The tag only shows after the person accepts, and they remove it whenever they want. Only people who allowed it in their protection choices can be tagged. Never on a protest post or a struggle community post. No face recognition: you type the @.
marcar.campo: @ of who is in the photo
marcar.feita: Request sent. The tag only shows if the person accepts.
marcar.aprovada: Tag added: this person had accepted in advance.
marcar.jaFeita: This person was already called for this post.

vale.dica: Paste the address of a case published on Vale o Escrito. The link leads to the case file, right here on the site.
vale.naoAchou: This case is not published on Vale o Escrito.
vale.umBasta: One of the two is enough: the source link or the Vale o Escrito check.

erro: That did not work right now. Try again in a moment.

erros.coautoria_fechada: This person cannot be called for this post.
erros.fonte_ja_dada: The author already added the source to this post.
erros.marcar_luta: Struggle community posts have no tags: a photo with names is a risk for the people in it.
erros.marcar_ato: Protest posts have no tags: a photo with names is a risk for the people in it.
erros.marcar_fechado: This person has not allowed you to tag them.
erros.invalido:vale: This case is not published on Vale o Escrito.
erros.invalido:fonte: Write a link that starts with http:// or https://.
erros.invalido:sem_imagem: Tags only work on posts with a photo.
erros.invalido:propria: That does not apply to your own post.
erros.nao_encontrado: We could not find this person or this post.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many times in a row. Wait a little.
